description: Fork of exp336 (40.44 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.6475). Single trade: E (embedding_dim, x_lut stream width) 64 -> 96. Effects: tok_emb_E params 2.10M -> 3.15M (+1.05M); out_proj n_outputs = E so out_proj params 6.29M -> 9.44M (+3.15M, since L0/L1 64*256*96 = 1.57M each, L2-5 same uniform 1.57M each); qkv/v/residual LUTs' input_dim becomes 96 (anchor sampling constraint only — no param change since n_outputs unchanged). d_v stays at 16. Total model 40.44 -> ~44.6 M. Tests if widening the x_lut stream from 64 to 96 (matching vanilla's n_embd's 'inner width' interpretation but at smaller scale) helps the LUT-LM information bottleneck.
